method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of a party to a civil claim (typically an interstate injury claim) asking which court can or should hear it, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the rules and the party's exported questions in one module (each question calls a rule defined beside it), worked cases in another; every judgment of the court an input; no regulative rule (the Act sets no time limit for a party); the Choice of Law (Limitation Periods) Act 1993 s 5 restated narrowly beside the one question that needs it; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Jurisdiction of Courts (Cross-vesting) Act 1987, Act No. 29/1987, Version No. 026 (incorporating amendments as at 1 July 2015), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/jurisdiction-of-courts-cross-vesting-act-1987.txt (text sha256 5aed7444108de8482e547ad8ec94a006654c2d0174b5226c17f666a02d59440f), converted from the Word file saved by hand by the owner on 2026-11-07

seat: a party: a person who brings or answers a civil claim, typically an injury claim with an interstate side, and asks which court can or should hear it, whether it must move, which law applies and whether a transfer can be appealed (jcv-party.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run jcv-party.l4 ; l4 run jcv-cases-party.l4
checks.result: 126 assertions written, 126 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Every operative section: ss 3, 3A, 4(3)-(5), 5(1)-(4), (6)-(9), 6, 6A(1)-(3), 7, 8, 9 (implied), 10, 11(1), (3), 12, 13, 14(2); s 11 read with the Choice of Law (Limitation Periods) Act 1993 s 5. Out: ss 1, 2, 15-18 (machinery and transitional), s 14(3) (interpretation), the Commonwealth's and other States' cross-vesting Acts (not deposited; their mirror transfers answer 'not covered'), and every discretion's outcome. Reasons in NOTES.md.
